frozen_parent_interface.swisher: E_p == -2p (mod p^3) for p congruent 2 modulo 3

companion_sequence.recurrence_derivation: Let S_n be the numerator defining a_n. Then S_(n+1)=216 S_n + (6n+1)binom(2n,n)^2binom(3n,n); the stated recurrence follows from D_(n+1)/D_n=2(2n+3)/n.

singular_boundary.uniqueness: Among 1<=n<p, 2n+3 is divisible by p exactly at n=s, where 2s+3=p.
singular_boundary.equivalence: Under the frozen high-tail and Swisher interfaces, C_p == 0 (mod p^3) iff B_p == 0 (mod p^3).
singular_boundary.strictness: The only remaining hypergeometric companion quotient a_s uses k=0,...,(p-5)/2, strictly below the original endpoint M=(2p-1)/3; the upper part is replaced by explicit first-order back-propagation.

source_valuation_zones.meaning: The entire upper zone is homogeneous modulo p^2; only one unit source occurs immediately above the singular step.

literature_boundary.sun_a14: Zhi-Wei Sun, Open Conjectures on Congruences, arXiv:0911.5665, A14. The exact 216^(-k) weighted p^3 statement is treated as conjectural identification, not theorem input.
literature_boundary.swisher: Swisher (2015), On the supercongruence conjecture of van Hamme: the E_p congruence used here is proved.
literature_boundary.search_disposition: No verified exact prior theorem matching the W_p/C_p target was located in the bounded literature search performed for this task.

unresolved_residue: Prove or refute B_p == 0 (mod p^3) uniformly on p congruent 17 or 23 modulo 24, preferably by exploiting the unique singular recurrence step and the p-adic source zoning; do not fall back to a larger prime census.
